summary: CI&T Inc filed a Form 6-K containing its 1Q26 earnings release and unaudited interim financials. The filing reports revenue of $136.6 million (23.2% growth), adjusted EBITDA of $20.8 million, and diluted EPS of $0.06. There are no special-situation corporate events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or restructuring. This is a routine periodic earnings report by a foreign private issuer, analogous to a US 8-K earnings release. No actionable event-driven catalyst is present; the filing is purely operational and financial in nature.
